caption:
The video captures two white ceramic bowls decorated with purple and pink floral rims resting on a wooden surface beside a window. The nearer bowl contains a large glossy translucent mass, while the farther bowl holds a similar pale solid. A greenish cast falls across the left edge of the frame, and the bowls remain fixed in position relative to the camera throughout the visible excerpt. The nearer mass appears smooth and reflective overall.

Within the excerpt, the upper-left corner of the foreground mass loses its sharp edge and rounds downward. The solid slumps into a lower, smoother mound, and a pooled sheen becomes more apparent near the lower right of the bowl. The background mass shows only slight deformation, remaining in place.

The change is not a shift of the bowls or the masses across the frame, but a deformation inside each bowl. The foreground solid continues to soften its contours, with the angular crest becoming part of a rounded surface. The farther pale form similarly adjusts without leaving its dish.
